tailoring.headline: Java Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud Specialist with 5+ years SAP Hybris experience
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, microservices, and data integration between PIM, ERP and MDM. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, SQL performance tuning, and agile, techno-functional delivery with international stakeholders. I also lead code reviews, mentor junior developers, and drive AI-assisted analysis to accelerate releases.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Java Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited to join hmmh AG because of its reputation for innovative SAP Commerce solutions that empower global brands. With 5+ years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep Java, Spring and API expertise to deliver high-performing e-commerce experiences.

bullets.label: Full-Stack SAP Commerce
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end backend and frontend features on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) at Rockwell, covering product catalog, pricing and customer data, using Java, Spring and design patterns.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services and integrated PIM, ERP and MDM systems via DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring seamless data flow across global channels.

bullets.label: Performance & DevOps
bullets.text: Optimized SQL queries and FlexibleSearch, leading database refactoring that cut latency, and executed CI/CD pipelines on CCv2 with Docker and Kubernetes for reliable releases.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specs, and supported production UAT, bridging the gap between business and IT.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to hmmh AG.

tailoring.why_company: hmmh AG stands out as a leader in delivering cutting-edge SAP Commerce Cloud solutions that enable brands to scale digitally. Your commitment to innovation, agile delivery and close collaboration with clients aligns perfectly with my experience driving high-performance e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am eager to contribute my Java and integration expertise to help hmmh AG’s customers achieve seamless, future-ready commerce experiences.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to hmmh AG, leveraging my Java, Spring and integration skills to build innovative e-commerce solutions that drive client success.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about the Java Developer role at hmmh AG and would love to discuss how my Java, Spring and API integration experience can add value to your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Java Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Java Developer – SAP Commerce Cloud position at hmmh AG. With over five years of hands-on experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to your innovative projects. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
